scope: Corollary 9.2 (The same local channel for real projections) of the manuscript “Entanglement with zero distillable secret key in local dimension ten” (preprints/Entanglement-with-zero-distillable-secret-key-in-local-dimension-ten-September-27-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 272 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 be18f63c5a1d11a2), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 37. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Under the hypotheses of Proposition 9.1, suppose that every Pi is real symmetric in the fixed basis of CD, and put Λ = Ψ† : MD(C) → Mn(C). Then, on all complex inputs, Λ ◦ TD = Λ = Tn ◦ Λ, tr Λ(A) = Q tr A. (9.15) In particular, Λ/Q is a trace-preserving PPT channel. For ΦD = ΩD/ √ D, the normalized maximally entangled vector on CD ⊗ CD, one has C Q2D =  Λ Q ⊗ Λ Q  (ΦDΦ∗ D). (9.16) This is an entangled density operator on Cn ⊗ Cn in C .
